paper_metadata.title: Effect of Fe additions on microstructure and mechanical properties of a multi-component Nb-16Si-22Ti-2Hf-2Al-2Cr alloy at room and high temperatures

evidence.quote: Nb is one of the most attractive base metals to replace Ni-based superalloys for future high-temperature structural materials with an application temperature range in excess of 1200 /C14 C.
An investigation on the microstructural evolution and mechanical properties of Nb-16Si-22Ti-2Al-2Hf-2Cr-xFe alloys was performed.
